name: cluster-capacity-brief
title: Cluster capacity brief
for_each: SELECT id,code FROM clusters ORDER BY code

sections.title: Workload evidence
sections.sql: SELECT code,name,owner,cpu,memory_gib,data_state FROM workload_review WHERE cluster_id=$1 ORDER BY code

name: change-record
title: Capacity change record
for_each: SELECT id,code FROM changes ORDER BY code

sections.title: Original measurement
sections.sql: SELECT o.* FROM observations o JOIN changes c ON c.observation_id=o.id WHERE c.id=$1
